Graph class, to manipulate graphs in 2D.

detaileddescription.para: This class represents a 2D graph, allowing the creation, manipulation, and analysis of graphs derived from point clouds. It supports operations such as graph construction, traversal, and various geometric analyses. This class inherits from the Cloud class, leveraging the functionalities of point clouds while adding graph-specific methods.
